items.title: Legal Aspects and Data Privacy Laws (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Legal Aspects and Data Privacy Laws (PDF 135-136, printed 131-132).

blocks.text: Computing ke qanooni pehluon se murad woh rules aur regulations (qawaid o zawabit) hain jo technology aur digital maloomat ke istemal par lagu hote hain. Cybercrime se murad computers, networks ya internet ke zariye kiye gaye ghair-qanooni kaam hain, jaise hacking, identity theft aur online fraud (dhoka-dahi). Yeh qawaneen afraad, idaron aur muashre ko data aur technology ke ghalat istemal se bachate hain. Data privacy laws yaqeeni banate hain ke zaati aur hassas maloomat zimmedari se jama, store aur share ho. In qawaneen ko samajhna qanooni masail se bachata hai aur mehfooz digital amal ko barhata hai. Qanooni dhanchon (legal frameworks) ki pabandi online systems aur services par bharosa bhi barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Cybercrime kya hai? Teen misalein dein. Data privacy laws kya yaqeeni banate hain?
